F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.BCa: bias-corrected accelerated bootstrap over seeds, 5000 draws, alpha 0.05, key via fold_in(K_analysis, tag='bca_T_d_comparison')
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.IQR_overlap_def: IQR = [Q25,Q75] per condition; overlap = length(intersection)/min(length(IQR0),length(IQR8)); >0.80 indicates distributions coincide
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.decision: If FALSIFIED, u-recovery pacemaker hypothesis rejected on d-necessity leg; if not falsified (T shifts outside CI or IQR disjoint), hypothesis survives this leg
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.direction: Falsifies pacemaker claim that d matters: if T unchanged when d zeroed, d not causal for period
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.formal: Let T_{a=0.02,d=0} and T_{a=0.02,d=8} be per-seed T distributions (n=5 seeds, same seeds paired) in W=[1500,2000). FALSIFIED if ALL: (i) median(T_d0) in BCa 95% CI of median(T_d8) (5000 draws, K_analysis key), (ii) IQR overlap >80% (overlap length / min(IQR_Td0,IQR_Td8) >0.80), (iii) mean_rate_E >5 Hz in both conditions (not silent) on same seeds. Metric T = median peak-to-peak of r_E.
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.verbatim: d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged: FALSIFIED if median T(d=0) within BCa 95% CI of T(d=8) on same seeds W=[1500,2000) AND IQR overlap >80% AND rate>5Hz (not silent); metric T = median peak-to-peak of r_E

F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.decision: If FALSIFIED, u-recovery pacemaker hypothesis rejected on tau-tracking leg; requires monotonic T(tau) with significant rho and correct slope
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.formal: Across a_E scan at fixed d=8 (a in {0.01,0.02,0.04} => tau_u in {100,50,25} ms), with T per seed per a level (n=15 total: 5 seeds x3 tau), compute Spearman rho(T,tau_u) and linear slope of T vs tau_u (or T vs log tau). FALSIFIED if EITHER: (i) rho <0.40 with p >=0.05 (no monotonic tracking), OR (ii) slope not within 30% of predicted ln-ratio slope. Predicted slope: for recovery pacemaker, T ~ k*tau_u or T ~ k*ln(tau_u / tau0) per Izh single-cell scaling; predicted slope = (T_baseline / tau_baseline) * tau scale or derived ln-ratio: slope_pred = DeltaT_pred / Deltatau = T_{a=0.02} * ln(4)/ln( (1/0.01)/(1/0.04) )? Operationally: slope_pred = linear regression slope of log-spaced tau predictor vs observed T_baseline scaling; tolerance +-30% (0.70*slope_pred <= slope_obs <=1.30*slope_pred). If rho >=0.40 with p<0.05 AND slope within 30%, hypothesis survives this leg; else FALSIFIED.
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.predicted_slope_note: Predicted ln-ratio slope derived from single-E Izh scaling: T scales with tau_u (or ln tau), so going 25->100 ms (4x tau) predicts T ratio ~ ln(4)/ln(2) ~2 or linear ~4 depending on regime; prereg locks to linear tau scaling as default (slope_pred = T_{0.02}/50) and allows log-slope variant as sensitivity check reported separately — primary gate is linear within 30%
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.slope_tolerance: within 30% of predicted ln-ratio slope (i.e., observed slope in [0.70*pred, 1.30*pred])
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.verbatim: a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u: FALSIFIED if Spearman rho(T,tau_u) <0.40 with p>=0.05 OR slope of T vs tau_u not within 30% of predicted ln-ratio slope

falsifiers_per_R3_patch.joint_verdict: Hypothesis REJECTED if either falsifier fires (FALSIFIED); hypothesis SUPPORTED only if neither falsifier fires AND adequacy guards pass; otherwise UNRESOLVED_silent or INVALID [SUPERSEDED by joint_verdict_v2 in v2; regime_guard now required for SUPPORTED; see joint_examination_rule and regime_guard.]

joint_examination_rule.requirement: All observables must be reported jointly per seed per condition in the same receipt; T0 shift must not be interpreted without r_E/r_I/rho_volley/CV_T. Changing (a) or (d) changes general excitability as well as tau_u, so joint table is mandatory.
joint_examination_rule.H_clock_vs_H_excit: H_clock predicts T0 vs tau_u ordering and slope within 30% with stable r_E/r_I/rho_volley/CV_T; H_excit predicts T0 shift covaries with r_E/r_I >2x or rho_volley collapse, not tau_u ordering. Distinguish by Spearman rho(T0,tau_u) vs rho(T0,r_E) and by regime guard.
joint_examination_rule.verbatim_rule: A convincing recovery-clock result requires the period shift to follow predicted recovery ordering (Spearman rho vs tau_u, slope within 30% of ln-ratio) WHILE the phenomenon remains the same pulse regime (participation within delta, CV_T bounded). If intervention destroys regime or massively changes firing (rate changes >2x or participation collapses), outcome becomes UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM, not clock support.

falsifiers_per_R3_patch.joint_verdict_v2: Hypothesis REJECTED if either falsifier fires (FALSIFIED) per F1/F2. Hypothesis SUPPORTED only if neither falsifier fires AND adequacy guards pass AND regime_guard preserved (participation within 0.20, CV_T<=0.35, rates within 2x, no collapse) AND joint T0,f0,r_E,r_I,rho_volley table shows clock ordering. If period tracking appears to pass but regime guard fails (rate>2x or rho collapse or CV_T unbounded), outcome is UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM, not SUPPORTED. Ordering: INVALID > UNRESOLVED_silent > UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM > FALSIFIED > NEGATIVE > SUPPORTED. Preserves frozen E2 V1 NEGATIVE.
falsifiers_per_R3_patch.joint_verdict_v1_preserved: Hypothesis REJECTED if either falsifier fires (FALSIFIED); hypothesis SUPPORTED only if neither falsifier fires AND adequacy guards pass; otherwise UNRESOLVED_silent or INVALID

hypothesis.alternative: T tracks tau_u=1/a_E and depends on d_E after-spike jump
hypothesis.name: u_recovery_pacemaker
hypothesis.not_a_repair: This battery does not alter, re-score, or re-interpret frozen E2 V1 NEGATIVE_NOT_PING_LIKE verdict; V1/V2 remain sealed negatives. e2_c is a new prospective experiment branching from theta*.
hypothesis.null_like: T is independent of a_E/d_E (delay/topology or noise pacemaker)
hypothesis.scope: Tested at frozen theta* only; no claim about other operating points; bounded interpretation per E2_SYNTHESIS
hypothesis.statement: Population pulse period T at theta* is set by the E-cell recovery variable u (a_E/d_E), not by E-I loop delay or network topology. Under Izhikevich dynamics dv/dt=0.04v^2+5v+140-u+I, du/dt=a(bv-u), spike reset v<-65,u+=d, tau_u=1/a sets recovery timescale.

izhi_E_recovery.d_E_definition: post-spike increment of u (adaptation step); d_E in {0, 8.0}; 8.0 is native E value, 0 tests necessity of spike-triggered jump vs pure tau
izhi_E_recovery.tau_u_definition: tau_u = 1 / a_E (ms) in reduced units; a_E in {0.01,0.02,0.04} => tau_u in {100,50,25} ms

metric.W_primary_note: W=[1500,2000) is the frozen E2 V1 adequacy window; kept identical for comparability; no tuning
metric.computation: r_E = mean spikes per ms across 800 E neurons smoothed with same filtering as E2 pulse characterization only for peak detection; median peak-to-peak interval across detected pulses within W; returns T_ms per seed per condition
metric.definition: median peak-to-peak interval of r_E (excitatory population rate) in analysis window W=[1500,2000) ms; r_E binned at dt_ms 0.5 native (fs 2000 Hz); peak picking via parabolic interpolation consistent with e2_ping_prereg method
metric.name: T
metric.rate_guard: mean_rate_E >5 Hz required for T interpretation (not silent); if rate <=5 Hz, condition is UNRESOLVED_silent, not used for falsifier comparison
metric.joint_observables_note: v2 joint examination: per seed per condition report T0_ms, f0_Hz=1000/T0, r_E_Hz, r_I_Hz, rho_volley median, CV_T, N_cycles alongside T. Regime guard uses rho_volley delta 0.20 and CV_T bound 0.35; see causal_discriminator_H_clock_vs_H_excit and regime_guard.
metric.f0_derivation: f0_Hz = 1000.0 / T0_ms per seed; median f0 and IQR derived by transform; reciprocal consistency check: reporting both T0 and f0 mandatory.

FALSIFIED_vs_NEGATIVE.FALSIFIED: per frozen ordering: falsifier criterion met (d_zero leaves T unchanged OR a_scan does not track tau_u) with adequate rates => hypothesis falsified
FALSIFIED_vs_NEGATIVE.NEGATIVE: adequate but no falsifier fired and effect size absent yet not meeting falsifier contrarian threshold (e.g., rho 0.2 n.s.) => NEGATIVE (no evidence for pacemaker, but not falsified by strict contrarian)
FALSIFIED_vs_NEGATIVE.frozen_ordering_note: INVALID; !G_adequate -> UNRESOLVED; FALSIFIED per R3 falsifiers; NEGATIVE vs FALSIFIED per frozen ordering (E2 V1 NEGATIVE_NOT_PING_LIKE ordering preserved; this battery independent)

INVALID.handling: INVALID_* runs excluded from all aggregations, never pooled with valid; reported separately with seed/reason

UNRESOLVED.G_adequate: G_finite && G_active && G_population with G_finite: all V_m,u,spikes,sources,Q,H_K finite not NaN rate<200 |H_K|<=20; G_active: mean_rate_E>=0.5 && mean_rate_I>=0.5 && n_spiking>=10; G_population: active_E>=20 && active_I>=5 (inherited from e2_ping_prereg adequacy_gates)
UNRESOLVED.additional_UNRESOLVED: rate<=5 Hz => UNRESOLVED_silent (silent not falsifier-applicable); also gray-zone T unmeasurable
UNRESOLVED.handling: UNRESOLVED never counts as FALSIFIED or NEGATIVE; reported as assay not in regime

UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM.definition: Intervention destroys pulse regime or massively changes firing, so period shift cannot be attributed to recovery clock vs excitability. Triggers: rate ratio >2x (E or I) vs baseline, OR rho_volley collapse (<0.60 or delta>0.40), OR CV_T >0.35 unbounded/irregular, despite apparent T0 tracking.
UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM.handling: UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM is not SUPPORTED and not FALSIFIED; it is a mechanism-unresolved outcome distinct from UNRESOLVED_silent (rate<=5). Report T0,f0,r_E,r_I,rho_volley,CV_T jointly; do not claim clock support. Ordering: supersedes SUPPORTED but is superseded by INVALID and UNRESOLVED_silent and FALSIFIED.
UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM.verbatim: If intervention destroys regime or massively changes firing (rate changes >2x or participation collapses), outcome becomes UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM, not clock support.

taxonomy.ordering: INVALID_* > UNRESOLVED > FALSIFIED > NEGATIVE > SUPPORTED, per frozen E2 ordering: INVALID never pooled, !G_adequate -> UNRESOLVED, then falsifier logic, then negative vs support
taxonomy.ordering_v2: INVALID_* > UNRESOLVED_silent > UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM > FALSIFIED > NEGATIVE > SUPPORTED, per frozen E2 ordering plus v2 regime guard: UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM supersedes SUPPORTED but not FALSIFIED or silent. Original ordering preserved for v1 compat; v2 adds mechanism guard.

theta_star.weight_scale_reading: weight_mu scales all projection mus proportionally to nominal mu_EE=0.35: mu_X = mu_X_nom * weight_mu/0.35; sigmas unchanged (frozen)

causal_discriminator_H_clock_vs_H_excit.rationale: Changing (a) or (d) changes not only recovery timescale tau_u=1/a_E and after-spike jump d_E but also general excitability and mean firing rates. A shift in T0 could therefore arise via H_clock (period set by u-recovery dynamics) or via H_excit (period shortens/lengthens merely because excitability/rate changed, not because tau_u governs inter-volley recovery). C2 must distinguish these.

hypotheses.H_clock: T0=median peak-to-peak interval of r_E tracks tau_u (and independent of mean rate): Spearman rho(T0,tau_u) >=0.40 p<0.05 and slope within 30% of predicted ln-ratio, while r_E,r_I,rho_volley,CV_T remain in same pulse regime. f0=T0^-1 shows reciprocal tracking.
hypotheses.H_excit: T0 change is epiphenomenal to excitability: T0 shift correlates with r_E/r_I change or occurs only when rates change >2x or rho_volley collapses / CV_T degrades, not with tau_u ordering per se. T0 vs tau_u rho <0.40 n.s. or slope outside 30%, but rates/participation move strongly.
hypotheses.distinction_required: Report T0,f0,r_E,r_I,rho_volley,CV_T jointly per condition per seed; do not interpret T0 shift in isolation.

T0_ms.definition: Same as metric.T: median peak-to-peak interval of excitatory population rate r_E in W=[1500,2000) ms; per seed per condition; ms. Peak detection via parabolic interpolation on r_E smoothed as in E2 pulse characterization. Units ms.

f0_Hz.definition: f0 = 1 / T0, derived per seed per condition; f0_Hz = 1000.0 / T0_ms. Tracks reciprocal of T0; reported jointly to distinguish clock-frequency vs period representation. Units Hz.
f0_Hz.derivation: f0_Hz = 1000.0 / T0_ms per seed; median f0 and distribution reported alongside T0; same BCa/ IQR checks apply to f0 if T0 used (f0 CI derived by transform).

r_E_Hz.definition: Mean firing rate of E population (800 E neurons) in W=[1500,2000) ms: total E spikes in W / (800 * window_duration_s). Hz per neuron mean. Same as mean_rate_E in adequacy_gates.

r_I_Hz.definition: Mean firing rate of I population (200 I neurons) in W=[1500,2000) ms: total I spikes in W / (200 * window_duration_s). Hz per neuron mean.

rho_volley.definition: Volley participation: per detected cycle (consecutive r_E peaks), fraction of E neurons firing at least one spike within [peak - D/2, peak + D/2] or within inter-peak partition; rho_volley per cycle in [0,1]; reported as median over cycles in W per seed per condition, and as distribution. Equivalent to per-cycle rho_c; median rho_volley characterizes dense synchronous recruitment (baseline ~1.0 at theta*).
rho_volley.computation: Detected cycles = intervals between successive r_E peaks in W (requires N_cycles >=3 for stable rho). For each cycle c (partition by midpoints between peaks), rho_c = N_E_firing_in_cycle / 800. rho_volley_median = median_c rho_c. Also report mean and IQR. If N_cycles <3, rho_volley = UNDEFINED and regime guard FAIL -> UNRESOLVED.
rho_volley.baseline_at_theta_star: ~1.0 (globally synchronous pulse regime; see S_PULSE_CHARACTERIZATION.md and 11_E2_NEGATIVE_MECHANISTIC_INTERPRETATION.md)

CV_T.definition: Coefficient of variation of inter-volley periods: CV_T = std(T_cycle) / mean(T_cycle), where T_cycle are per-cycle peak-to-peak intervals (same T values used for median T0) in W per seed per condition. Dimensionless; bounded regime has CV_T <=0.35.
CV_T.computation: From detected peak times t_k in W (after smoothing), T_k = t_{k+1}-t_k; CV_T = sigma_T / mu_T if len(T_k) >=3 else None/UNDEFINED.
CV_T.origin: e2_ping_prereg.json G_cycle CV_T <=0.35; S_PULSE pulse irregularity guard

causal_discriminator_H_clock_vs_H_excit.reporting_requirement: Per condition per seed, report table row: T0_ms, f0_Hz, r_E_Hz, r_I_Hz, rho_volley_median, CV_T, N_cycles, mean_rate_E/I; aggregates: median/IQR per condition and deltas vs baseline (a=0.02,d=8). All five joint observables must appear together in the same receipt; T0 alone is insufficient for a clock claim.

regime_guard.purpose: Ensure phenomenon remains the same pulse regime across a_E/d_E interventions; distinguishes true recovery-clock tracking from excitability-driven regime change or destruction.
regime_guard.baseline_reference: Baseline condition e2_c_a02_d8_baseline (a=0.02,tau 50ms,d=8) is the frozen theta* pulse regime: dense synchronous pulses, participation ~1.0, CV_T ~0.002, interpulse ~138ms, rate >5 Hz.

participation_within_delta.formal: |rho_volley_median(condition) - rho_volley_median(baseline)| <= 0.20 absolute, evaluated on median over seeds (pooled median-of-medians or per-seed median delta median). Baseline ~1.0 => requires rho_condition >=0.80 median.
participation_within_delta.per_seed_also: Per-seed rho_volley_median >=0.60 absolute in each seed ( floor to avoid single-cycle dropout ); if any seed reports rho <0.60 in a condition, flag collapse.
participation_within_delta.collapse_definition: rho_volley_median <0.60 absolute OR delta_rho >0.40 (i.e., baseline 1.0 -> condition <0.60) in median => participation collapses.

CV_T_bounded.formal: CV_T <=0.35 per condition per seed median; regime-preserved requires median CV_T <=0.35 and |CV_T(condition)-CV_T(baseline)| <=0.15 absolute median. If baseline CV_T ~0.002, condition CV_T >0.35 => irregular / destroyed regime.

regime_preserved_criteria.N_cycles_sufficient: N_cycles >=3 per seed per condition for T0/rho/CV_T interpretation; <3 => T undefined => UNRESOLVED_silent (not regime comparison).
regime_preserved_criteria.rate_guard_for_regime: Mean_rate_E >5 Hz per condition (already in metric.rate_guard) for T interpretability; additionally adequacy G_adequate must pass.

rate_change_gt_2x.definition: Massively changes firing: ratio of mean rates between condition and baseline exceeds 2x in either direction for E or I.
rate_change_gt_2x.formal_E: ratio_E = median_r_E(condition) / median_r_E(baseline) (pooled medians over 5 seeds); triggers if ratio_E >2.0 or ratio_E <0.50 (i.e., max(ratio_E, 1/ratio_E) >2.0).
rate_change_gt_2x.formal_I: ratio_I = median_r_I(condition) / median_r_I(baseline); triggers if max(ratio_I, 1/ratio_I) >2.0.
rate_change_gt_2x.trigger: If either E or I ratio exceeds 2x, OR per-seed mean ratio median >2x, then intervention massively changes excitability => UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM, not clock support. Report both r_E and r_I ratios.
rate_change_gt_2x.rationale: Large rate excursions indicate excitability change dominates; period shift could be rate-mediated, not tau_u-mediated.

participation_collapses.definition: Volley participation collapses as above: median rho_volley <0.60 or delta_rho >0.40.
participation_collapses.trigger: If rho_volley collapse holds, regime destroyed => UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM.

CV_T_degrades.definition: CV_T >0.50 or delta CV_T >0.30 (substantially irregular) indicates rhythm degraded.
CV_T_degrades.trigger: CV_T median >0.35 already fails regime-preserved; >0.50 or irregular => UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM if T shift otherwise appears to track.

mechanism_unresolved_triggers.silent_or_insufficient: If any condition silent (rate<=5) or N_cycles<3, outcome is UNRESOLVED_silent, not Mechanism verdict.

regime_guard.verbatim_rule: A convincing recovery-clock result requires the period shift to follow predicted recovery ordering (Spearman rho vs tau_u, slope within 30% of ln-ratio) WHILE the phenomenon remains the same pulse regime (participation within delta, CV_T bounded). If intervention destroys regime or massively changes firing (rate changes >2x or participation collapses), outcome becomes UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM, not clock support.
regime_guard.consequence: Regime guard is conjunctive with falsifier tests: SUPPORTED (H_clock) requires BOTH (i) T0 tracking passes (rho>=0.40 p<0.05 and slope within 30%) AND (ii) regime preserved (participation within 0.20, CV_T<=0.35, rates within 2x, no collapse). If (i) passes but (ii) fails (rate>2x or rho collapse or CV unbounded), verdict is UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM, not SUPPORTED. If (i) fails, verdict is FALSIFIED or NEGATIVE regardless of (ii), per joint_verdict ordering: INVALID > UNRESOLVED_silent > UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM > FALSIFIED > NEGATIVE > SUPPORTED, where UNRESOLVED_MECHANISM supersedes SUPPORTED but not FALSIFIED.
